status: Fixed in source; frozen publication pending
finding: Runner-sync accepts an active ATM-FRAMEWORK-TEMP claim as a queue member and publication authority, but broker runner-sync takeover-publication previously required a conventional task ledger file. When a sealed build found pre-existing generated outputs, the only official digest-bound takeover command rejected its own queue-head task with ATM_RUNNER_PUBLICATION_INVENTORY_INCOMPLETE, creating a bootstrap dead end.
expectedBehavior: Every runner-sync recovery operation must recognize the same authority forms as runner-sync admission. A framework-temp takeover is valid only while its lock is live, its actor matches, its task is the current queue-head member, and its sealed source SHA matches exactly. Missing, expired, released, foreign-actor, non-head, or SHA-mismatched requests must fail closed.
evidenceOrRepro: Queue runner-sync-220319fe accepted ATM-FRAMEWORK-TEMP-codex-gpt-5-4-mini for sealed source 7c5c427d05c1e2493bb9d9fab9ee2d577a07cdd3. The sealed build succeeded but listed 30 preserved pre-existing generated outputs. The prescribed broker runner-sync takeover-publication command then failed because .atm/history/tasks/ATM-FRAMEWORK-TEMP-codex-gpt-5-4-mini.json does not exist, although the active framework lock and queue request did. Focused regression: tests/cli/runner-sync-framework-temp-hotfix.test.ts.
followUp: Publish this fix in the frozen runner and verify the exact takeover receipt allows one successful sealed rebuild without overwriting active foreign ownership. Improve the initial publication failure to emit the complete bounded takeover command so operators do not have to discover the recovery route manually. Keep operation-owned generated residue cleanup tracked under ATM-GOV-0363 rather than weakening ownership checks globally.
